The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is visible on the left, showing a small eye and broad shape. The limbs are short and partially obscured by the angle and shadows. The tail extends towards the right, appearing thick at the base.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'texture_anomaly' noted in the yellow spots. AI models often struggle to apply the same 'wet/glossy' shader to colored patterns as they do to the base skin. Also, scrutinize the limb-ground contact points; 'melting' is common in amphibian generations due to similar colors between limbs and dark soil. Do not rely solely on the classifier; even if it says 'salamander', structural defects in the limbs or tail tip (if visible) are critical failures.
